capabilities: Capture Telegram text, photos, links and voice messages into the daily note
Chat with an AI companion that reads the last week of daily notes and a profile note
Maintain a profile note with approved long-term facts and a weekly rewritten recent section
Define custom trigger commands that save to notes or prompt the model
Send chat replies as voice messages through a configurable text-to-speech command
disambiguation: Not a Telegram sync or messaging client for Obsidian; it only talks to a bot you create yourself.
extras: Desktop only and Obsidian must be running for the bot to answer. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Chat transcripts are deleted after the weekly profile update by design. Voice replies need OGG Opus output from the TTS command.
intentEvidence: It is a modified version of the community plugin Telegram Inbox
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture thoughts from a phone via Telegram, and AI chats answer without knowing what is in your vault or daily notes.

relations.evidence: Based on the community plugin Telegram Inbox by icealtria.
Together with Nautilus Spiral, a plugin by the same author that draws today's events and to-dos
done 写稿 2h and doing 写稿 update the matching task in today's note (this one also needs the done-to-top plugin)

requires.name: Telegram account and own bot from @BotFather
Anthropic API key or OpenAI-compatible endpoint key (or Claude Code CLI login / local Ollama)
Claude Code CLI for that backend; a local TTS program for voice replies
Nautilus Spiral and done-to-top for schedule and task phrases

summary: Telegram bot that saves messages you send it into today's daily note and chats as an AI companion that has read your recent notes.
